color1Attr.comment: The first color used in the checkerboard pattern.
color1Attr.label: Color 1
color1Attr.name: color1

color2Attr.comment: The second color used in the checkerboard pattern.
color2Attr.label: Color 2
color2Attr.name: color2

texcoordAttr.comment: The input 2d space. Default is the first texture coordinates.
texcoordAttr.label: Texture Coordinates
texcoordAttr.name: texcoord

uvoffsetAttr.comment: The offset of the checkerboard pattern along each axis. Default is (0, 0).
uvoffsetAttr.label: UV Offset
uvoffsetAttr.name: uvoffset

uvtilingAttr.comment: The tiling of the checkerboard pattern along each axis, with higher values producing smaller squares. Default is (8, 8).
uvtilingAttr.label: UV Tiling
uvtilingAttr.name: uvtiling
